test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Higher Secondary Level) Official Paper (Held On: 30 Jul, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: 32 men can dig a canal in 12 days. 3 days after they started working, 10 more men joined them. In how many more days will the remaining work be completed?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total work = 32 × 12 = 384 man-days

Work done in 3 days = 32 × 3 = 96 man-days

Remaining work = 384 − 96 = 288 man-days

After 3 days, men = 32 + 10 = 42

⇒ Remaining time = 288 ÷ 42 = 48 ÷ 7 days

**∴ The correct answer is **6.85** days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total work = 32 × 12 = 384 man-days

⇒ Work done in first 3 days = 32 × 3 = 96 man-days

⇒ Remaining work = 384 − 96 = 288 man-days

⇒ New number of men = 32 + 10 = 42

⇒ Time for remaining work = 288 ÷ 42

⇒ = 48 ÷ 7 days

⇒ = 6.85 days

**∴ The correct answer is **6.85** days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Man-Days Concept

Total Work = Number of Men × Number of Days.

Efficiency Assumption

All workers are assumed to have equal efficiency unless stated otherwise.

Work and Time Relation

For fixed work, Men × Days = Constant.

If workforce increases, the remaining work gets completed in fewer days due to higher combined efficiency.
